```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"

    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Em dash&mdash;used for parenthetical remarks&mdash;is common. Ellipsis&hellip; indicates omission. Non-breaking&nbsp;space.</p>", ConversionOptions())

}
```
